description: In front of the hands on a green cloth are a blue beaded strand, a thin cord, a tape dispenser, and several piles of colorful beads. The left hand steadies the blue beaded strand and pinches the cord near its end while the right hand moves rightward to pick up a bead from the dark pile, then brings it back toward the cord and uses fingertips to guide the bead onto or off the cord, briefly making the cord a two-hand object as both hands align and adjust it.
